prompts.identityCorrect: <image1> is the selected new adult Rubelia white bikini illustration own head crop. <image2> is the SAME adult Rubelia existing approved face and is the sole face identity reference. Redraw ONLY the face inside {faceEditRect} to match her established facial structure, clear vivid green eyes, fine dark lashes, soft rounded cheeks, small nose and natural closed-lip smile. Preserve image1 head tilt, face size and feature positions; do not copy image2 outfit or replace hair/ornaments. Keep all hair, red gemstone gold ornament, earrings, bikini, bare hands, lighting and framing unchanged. No donor-face transplant.
prompts.pose: Generate ONE complete new pose illustration of the SAME adult Rubelia from <image1>, wearing exactly its approved opaque white triangle halter bikini, small fabric ruffle edging, thin neck-tie strings, small front knot and hip-side tied bows. The top is soft unstructured swim fabric, not rounded molded bra cups or underwire lingerie. <image2> is its own head crop for face identity only. Preserve the approved face, green eyes, red hair, gold-red hair ornament, earrings and body proportions. Keep an unusually large head including entire hair and ornament through upper thighs filling nearly the entire 1280-square height; leave margin for both complete intact bare arms and hands. Pose intent: {intent}. Plain opaque white background, no text, no props, no gloves, no books, no coat, no redesign of the bikini.

poseIntents.writing: Focused working posture with a slightly downward gaze, both eyes open and both hands near waist height as a writing-like gesture without a pen or any prop; complete hands visible.
poseIntents.failed: Restrained concern after a failed task: head slightly lowered and shoulders gently drawn inward, BOTH green eyes OPEN and face clear. One bare hand rests over the opposite forearm low below the waist in a self-comforting posture; the other bare hand and all fingertips remain clearly visible. Two arms only. This is a low crossed-arm posture, not the writing hand clasp or a stopping palm.
poseIntents.cancelled: Gentle resigned acknowledgment of an interrupted task. One bent arm presents its complete open bare palm toward the viewer at mid-chest height as a small STOP gesture, well below the chin. The opposite arm hangs beside the hip with the entire hand and fingertips visible. BOTH green eyes OPEN; calm straight head, face unobstructed, two arms only.
poseIntents.disconnected: Puzzled by a lost connection: small questioning head tilt, both green eyes OPEN. One forearm lifts its open bare hand PALM-UP below the chest as a questioning gesture, not a viewer-facing stopping palm. The opposite arm extends down beside the hip with its whole hand and all fingertips clearly visible. Exactly two arms; no hands behind the back, in pockets or hidden by the torso.
poseIntents.bored: Quiet prolonged-idle fidget: visibly shift weight to one hip and subtly tilt the shoulders, with a subdued but BOTH-EYES-OPEN expression. One bare hand loosely holds the opposite wrist LOW beside the hip, below the waist rather than the central writing clasp. Both complete hands and fingertips visible. No hand near the face, no face obstruction, exactly two arms.
poseIntents.happy: Warm satisfied OPEN-EYED smile and an upright buoyant posture. Both forearms open gently OUT to the sides at waist height, both complete bare hands relaxed with palms angled upward, distinct from waiting hanging arms and the one-hand disconnected gesture. Keep clear margins around both hands and all fingertips. Two arms only, face completely clear; do not raise hands into the face.
poseIntents.head-tap: Brief shy surprise from a head click. TWO ARMS ONLY: her image-left arm bends at the elbow and its bare hand rises beside her red hair at temple height, fingers clearly visible never crossing either eye. This replaces the original image-left hanging arm: there is NO additional arm or hand hanging on image-left below it. Her image-right arm alone hangs at her side, its one bare hand fully visible. Head tilts a little toward the raised hand, both green eyes open, face entirely clear.
poseIntents.torso-tap: Mild playful surprise from a torso click: a small backward upper-body recoil while BOTH green eyes stay OPEN. One bare hand rests over her own upper chest below the neck as a self-touch response; the opposite arm hangs beside the hip with its complete hand and fingertips visible. No arm near hair, no face obstruction, exactly two arms, distinct from the head-tap temple gesture.
poseIntents.head-pet: Content gentle OPEN-EYED smile in response to an extended head stroke: a soft sustained sideways head-and-shoulder lean and relaxed shoulders. Both bare hands remain LOW, loosely together below the waist, all fingertips clearly visible, unlike the raised temple hand of head-tap or chest hand of torso-tap. Exactly two arms; keep face and both green irises entirely unobstructed.

registration.method: Similarity (scale + translation) coarse-to-fine search on panel 1 (open eyes) over the own nose/eye/eyebrow patch with front hair and the neutral mouth excluded. closedLids.method: Hue-independent luma contrast below local skin inside the eye anchor box; own front hair and eyebrow alpha excluded; upstream ridge tracing and edge unmixing retained.

Original locations and runtime details remain only in the private stage audit. Existing file SHA-256 and byte counts describe original files, not these path labels or this projected JSON.
privacyLimit: Structured execution fields and standalone host paths/URLs are omitted or converted; free-form text (including verbatim user requests, prompts, rights and licenses) is not scrubbed and may contain private text. Carried reference files and manifest/attribution text are not sanitized by this projection.
